topics.name: SpaceX IPO
topics.summary: SpaceX planning to raise ~$30B at a $1.5 trillion valuation—potentially the largest IPO in history—driven by need to fund AI data centers in space, accelerate Starlink, and deploy capital faster than government competition.

topics.name: Disney/OpenAI SORA Partnership
topics.summary: Disney invested $1B in OpenAI and signed a 3-year licensing deal with 1-year exclusivity allowing SORA to use 200+ characters; curated AI-generated content will stream on Disney+; hosts debated timeline for meaningful viewership impact.

topics.name: Oracle Earnings Miss and AI Spending Concerns
topics.summary: Oracle shares tumbled after revenue fell short while spending rose; $523B in remaining performance obligations but only ~$68B market cap; market questioning whether Oracle was misled about AI economics by OpenAI or Jensen Huang.

topics.name: GPT 5.2 Launch
topics.summary: OpenAI launched GPT 5.2 on its 10-year anniversary; 90% ARC-AGI score up from 17.6%, representing a 390x efficiency improvement year-over-year; Fidji Simo discussed unlocking spreadsheet/slide generation as key enterprise use case.

topics.name: AI Enterprise Adoption Plateau
topics.summary: Ramp's AI index showed flat 45% business adoption in November; OpenAI slightly declining while Anthropic and Google gained; debate over whether models need to become more agentic and job-aware rather than just smarter to drive the next adoption wave.

topics.name: Hollywood M&A: Netflix vs Skydance for WBD
topics.summary: Extended negotiation for Warner Brothers Discovery with Netflix and David Ellison/Skydance competing; Zaslav playing both sides to drive price above $30/share; deal expected to extend into 2026; David Ellison needs WBD to execute his full Hollywood consolidation thesis.

topics.name: Autonomous Vehicles as Public Health Priority
topics.summary: Jonathan Slotkin argued Waymo's 100M-mile safety data makes AV deployment a medical urgency for 40,000 annual US traffic deaths; regulatory capture and plaintiff bar are key barriers; insurance pricing differentials will eventually accelerate deployment.

topics.name: Space-Based AI Data Centers
topics.summary: SpaceX planning modified Starlink satellites as foundation for orbital compute; debate over feasibility timelines with 1GW equivalent needing ~10,000 satellites; Elon Musk projects 100 terawatts of AI compute scalability enabling Kardashev Type 2 progress.

topics.name: Disney vs Google Copyright Infringement
topics.summary: Disney sent a cease and desist to Google demanding it stop using Disney IP to train Gemini and distributing infringing images branded with the Gemini logo; Disney appears to be deliberately choosing OpenAI as its AI partner while opposing Google.

topics.name: Elon Musk Prediction Track Record
topics.summary: Review of Musk's history of bold predictions; misses include Mars greenhouse demo, humans on Mars by 2024, tourist moon trips by 2018; hits include reusable orbital rockets and ongoing Starship development; framed as acceptable given unique ambition level.

topics.name: Broadcom Earnings Beat
topics.summary: Broadcom beat Q4 estimates on EPS and revenue, stock up ~3% after hours; framed as continued validation of AI infrastructure spending thesis.

topics.name: Salesforce AgentForce Growth
topics.summary: AgentForce ARR at $540M and up 4.3x year-over-year; Mark Benioff may rename the company to reflect the agent-first strategy.

topics.name: Peptide Therapy and Health Optimization
topics.summary: Jonathan Slotkin discussed growing clinician adoption of peptides and injectables for health-span; 15-20% of surveyed clinicians are personally using more than one injectable; framed as an emerging 'Peptide Nation' trend.

topics.name: Presidential AI Challenge
topics.summary: Melania Trump announced a nationwide student AI challenge across all 50 states offering $10,000 per team member, cloud credits, and presidential certificates; aimed at building AI expertise in American youth.
